name: go-window
description: Finds the best time to go outside inside your real free hours, explained by a local open-weight model, and learns your personal limits.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "cross-env GO_WINDOW_DEV=1 node --watch --import tsx src/server/index.ts" "vite"
scripts.start:lan: vite build && cross-env HOST=0.0.0.0 node --import tsx src/server/index.ts
